title: iPhone 18 Pro camera rumors point to a bigger periscope zoom
summary: Supply-chain chatter suggests a larger sensor and upgraded tetraprism zoom for Apple’s next Pro phones.
content_text: Reports from Asian suppliers hint at a larger telephoto sensor, improved periscope stabilization, and incremental gains to low-light zoom. Apple’s plans could shift before launch.

title: Microsoft ships another Windows 11 update for Copilot+ PCs and Recall
summary: The latest 24H2 patch tightens privacy controls and fixes a handful of Copilot+ compatibility bugs.
content_text: The update adds clearer toggles for Recall snapshots, expands device eligibility checks, and patches an issue that caused some NPU laptops to miss Copilot+ features after upgrade.

title: OpenAI’s latest enterprise push is all about controls, not just bigger models
summary: New admin tooling, logging, and data residency options aim to make GPT deployments easier to audit.
content_text: OpenAI is leaning into governance features like per-workspace policies, exportable logs, and regional processing. Pricing tiers bundle higher context limits with compliance add-ons.

title: Switch 2: what stood out in our first extended play session
summary: A brighter screen, quieter fans, and slightly sturdier Joy-Cons — but battery life is the real question.
content_text: After a few hours with the new hardware, the screen pop and improved grip are immediate. Performance feels smoother in first-party titles, while battery estimates still vary widely.

title: Tesla’s FSD v14 wide release focuses on smoother city driving
summary: Release notes highlight fewer hard brakes and better lane selection, plus some new caveats in construction zones.
content_text: The rollout appears staggered by hardware revision. Drivers report improved behavior at unprotected left turns, but the system still struggles with temporary lane markings and cones.

title: Netflix’s Stranger Things season 5 trailer leans into the endgame
summary: Hawkins is closing in on Vecna, and the trailer teases a big time jump and a darker tone.
content_text: The new footage hints at government containment, a fractured group, and a return to the Upside Down’s origins. Netflix still hasn’t pinned down an exact release date.

title: Senators revive the Kids Online Safety Act with new carve-outs
summary: A revised draft adds limits on enforcement and narrows requirements for smaller platforms.
content_text: The updated bill tweaks the duty-of-care language and shifts some obligations toward app stores. Privacy advocates say the changes help, but enforcement remains a sticking point.

title: Sonos Ace 2 review: better tuning, same identity crisis
summary: Sonos fixes some rough edges and improves ANC, but the app story still drags the headphones down.
content_text: The Ace 2 sound is more balanced and the noise canceling is stronger on transit. Multipoint is reliable, yet key settings remain locked behind a sometimes-unpredictable Sonos app.

title: Pixel Watch 4 leaks show a slightly thicker design and new buttons
summary: Renders point to a larger battery and an extra side control, with Google’s usual wellness focus intact.
content_text: The images suggest slimmer bezels but a chunkier case. A new side button may handle quick workouts or Google Assistant. Expect the same Fitbit-style metrics with added coaching.

title: Starship flight 12 investigation points to a plumbing issue
summary: Regulators say a propellant leak likely triggered the anomaly; SpaceX is proposing design changes.
content_text: The report cites a valve issue that led to unexpected pressure changes. SpaceX says it will modify feed lines and add extra sensors ahead of the next integrated test flight.

title: iOS 20 could bring on-device translation to Messages
summary: A rumored feature would translate incoming texts automatically, with an option to keep the original.
content_text: The feature is said to run locally for common languages, using Apple’s neural engines. It may ship as part of a broader Messages refresh aimed at reducing spam and scams.

title: Instagram is testing AI summaries in search results
summary: The feature generates short blurbs for topics and creators, and it’s rolling out to a small test group.
content_text: Meta is experimenting with AI-generated summaries that appear above search results. The company says it uses signals from posts and profiles, with controls to report bad output.

title: Galaxy Tab S11 Ultra review: big screen, bigger ambition
summary: Samsung’s largest tablet yet is fast and gorgeous, but it’s still searching for a killer software workflow.
content_text: The 14.8-inch OLED is stunning for video and multitasking. Performance is excellent, and the S Pen remains great, but Android tablet apps still feel inconsistent for pro work.

title: Ford’s BlueCruise 1.5 adds smoother lane changes and better mapping
summary: The update expands hands-free coverage and promises fewer abrupt disengagements on complex interchanges.
content_text: Ford says it has refreshed map data for more highways and tuned its lane-change behavior to reduce ping-ponging. The rollout begins with 2025 and 2026 model-year vehicles.

title: Xbox Game Pass family plan could be returning in select regions
summary: A new support doc hints at a limited rollout, with pricing that varies by market.
content_text: Microsoft appears to be testing a family tier again after prior pilots ended. The document references account sharing limits and region-based verification for invited members.

title: Google adds real-time collaboration to Gemini Canvas
summary: The new feature lets teams co-edit prompts and outputs, with version history and access controls.
content_text: Gemini Canvas now supports shared workspaces, comments, and exportable changes. Google is positioning it as a lighter alternative to docs for rapid prototyping and analysis.

title: TikTok proposes a new US data oversight board as scrutiny ramps up
summary: The company says the board would review access requests and publish transparency reports.
content_text: TikTok’s plan includes third-party audits and a US-based governance structure. Lawmakers remain skeptical, arguing prior commitments haven’t fully addressed national security risks.

title: Disney Plus is raising prices again, and bundles are changing too
summary: The ad-free tier gets pricier while bundle discounts shrink, as streaming services chase profitability.
content_text: Disney says the increase will fund more originals and live sports. Some subscribers can keep current pricing for a limited time, depending on billing cycle and region.

title: Valve tweaks Deck Verified badges ahead of the big Steam sale
summary: A new “Playable with caveats” label aims to make compatibility clearer for Steam Deck owners.
content_text: Valve says the updated badges reflect common friction points like launcher logins and tiny text. The changes roll out gradually across the store and Deck’s library view.

title: Amazon removes an Alexa voice-shopping feature after complaints
summary: Users said accidental purchases were too easy, even with the opt-in setting enabled.
content_text: Amazon confirmed it’s rolling back a voice-shopping flow that relied on a short confirmation phrase. The company says it will add stronger safeguards before revisiting the feature.
